_comment: More of the electrical age (LV, ADR 0131), loaded after items.json with the same schema. Machines are MachineEntity (ADR 0117): `machine` {watts, inputs} (ADR 0123), their process recipes in lv_recipes.json.

items.name: Extractor
items._note: squeezes resin from logs and rubber from resin: rubber without tar or sulfur

items.name: Cutter
items._note: a steel saw blade on a motor: six planks a log, lenses from glass

items.name: Extruder
items._note: pushes hot metal through a die: pipes, gears, rods and tin cans without the anvil

items.name: Canning Machine
items._note: seals cooked food in tin cans: canned food never spoils

items.name: Electric Compressor
items._note: presses coke or coal into carbon electrodes, plant fibre into cordage

items.name: Electrolyzer
items._note: refines crushed ore on a carbon electrode: one ingot per crushed ore, no crucible or bloomery

items.name: Scrubber
items._note: ADR 0141: takes sludge from pipes or buckets into its tank: sulfur out, clean water from its back port; settled waste ground back to dirt

items.name: Sticky Resin
items._note: pressed out of a log in the extractor: binds a tool's haft like birch tar, makes raw rubber like tar, lights torches

items.name: Tin Can
items._note: four from a tin ingot in the extruder

items.name: Canned Meat
items._note: two cooked meat in a can: keeps forever

items.name: Canned Fish
items._note: two cooked fish in a can: keeps forever

items.name: Canned Vegetables
items._note: three vegetables in a can: keeps forever

items.name: Steel Rod
items._note: two from a steel ingot in the extruder; the assembler drives two electric pistons with one

items.name: Carbon Electrode
items._note: compressed coke: the electrolyzer burns one per two crushed ore

items.name: Diving Mask
items._note: two lenses in a rubber seal: breath lasts three times as long under water, and no smoke gets in (ADR 0155)

items.name: Spyglass
items._note: two lenses in a copper pipe: held, the zoom key looks eight times closer

items.name: Hand Drill
items._note: a steel pick head on a geared crank: almost twice a steel pick's speed with no steam

items.name: Heavy Copper Cable
items._note: 16 mm^2 of copper in rubber: under half the loss of the hide-sleeved cable and nearly twice its amps (ADR 0123)
